intro.h2: Condo and Home Remodels in South Pasadena and Gulfport
paragraphs: CRUSH IT Renovations LLC handles bathroom remodeling in South Pasadena, along with kitchens, condo makeovers and tile repairs. The company works from Sailboat Key Blvd S, and the owner thanks customers by neighborhood in review replies, from South Pasadena to Gulfport and Harbourside.

Three things stand out in the reviews. Timing: one condo owner needed the work done within a set time frame, and they made it, taking the condo from drab to fab. Price: a patio tile repair came in lower than other bids and was done quickly. Communication: a South Pasadena homeowner calls the team very communicative, on time and prompt, and could not be happier with the finished bathroom.

about.text: CRUSH IT Renovations LLC is a remodeling company based at 7882 Sailboat Key Blvd S in South Pasadena, Florida. It focuses on kitchen and bathroom remodeling, and reviewers describe condo makeovers and tile repairs too. The owner replies to reviews personally and thanks each customer by neighborhood, from South Pasadena to Gulfport and Harbourside. Customers describe the team as professional, clean, detailed and quick, with prices that came in under other bids. It holds a 4.8 rating from 12 Google reviews.

service_area.h2: Bathroom Remodeling in South Pasadena and Gulfport
service_area.text: CRUSH IT Renovations works from 7882 Sailboat Key Blvd S in South Pasadena, Florida. The owner's replies to Google reviews thank customers in South Pasadena, Gulfport and Harbourside, so those are areas the company has already worked in. If you live nearby and are not sure whether your address is covered, call (727) 490-9451 and ask before you book your bathroom or kitchen project.

items.a: CRUSH IT Renovations is open Monday through Thursday from 8 AM to 5 PM, and Friday and Saturday from 8 AM to 3 PM. It is closed on Sunday. You can also email crushitrenovate@gmail.com at any time and describe your project.

Yes. A Gulfport customer wrote that her condo went from drab to fab, with quality work that was clean and detailed and finished within the time frame she needed. Mention any building rules, such as work hours or elevator use, when you call.

Yes. One customer's patio tile had buckled, and CRUSH IT repaired it with smooth, even tiles. She said it was done quickly and professionally and that the price was lower than other bids. Call to describe the repair and get a price.

The company is based on Sailboat Key Blvd S in South Pasadena, and the owner's replies to reviews thank customers in South Pasadena, Gulfport and Harbourside. If your home is nearby but outside those areas, call (727) 490-9451 to check your address before you book.

Ask for the license number and proof of insurance when you call, along with any warranty terms. Florida homeowners can look up a contractor's license with the state before signing, and it is fair to ask for these details on any remodel, large or small.
